title: Reading — Words, Lines, and a First Passage
label: ch:it-prima-lettura
canDo: I can read an Italian word cold, follow a line whose subject lives inside the verb, and hold a whole passage without translating it word by word.

payoff.summary: Forty-seven words of Italian with no new word in them, including the one place a reader has to decide whether perché is asking or answering with nothing on the page to say which.
